summary: A 1970 memo presenting the new host-to-host protocol, with changes from the earlier design in RFC 11 that came out of a December 1969 network meeting. It was described as not yet detailed enough to write a network control program from. It was updated by RFC 36 and RFC 47.

eli5.summary: This note gives a newer set of rules for how two computers start, run and end a conversation, improving on the older rules.

questions: what is the network control program
